key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as bond yields climb, signalling sustained risk-off sentiment
RBA signals continued hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an interest-rate pincer for households
AUD 'trapdoor opens' on hawkish RBA stance and global risk aversion, pressuring commodity exporters
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; Victorian unemployment and renter stress intensify
Gold exploration sector active: Aurum 155g/t hit, Zenith six-for-six in WA, Kuniko NSW drilling complete
$2.7B in ASX capital raises this week raises dilution concerns across small/mid-caps
Data centre boom straining energy supply, creating structural tension for energy sector
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/consumer discretionary

sectors.trend: Gold exploration names (Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko) showing strong assay results; small-caps (Anax, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow, Mamba) active but capital-raise dilution at $2.7B weekly level is a headwind. Iron ore/coal exposed to China-Trump geopolitical shift.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors offer relative strength in a risk-off tape; large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face AUD weakness offsetting commodity prices. Dilution risk elevated for small-caps.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking cycle supports NIMs but rising unemployment and renter stress (50%+ struggling) threaten credit quality. Bond yield climb pressures equity valuations. Star casino licence suspension hits gaming-adjacent revenue.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates short-term but face rising NPLs. Star Group (SGH.AX) under pressure from suspended licence.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating structural energy demand but 'energy bust' risk from supply constraints. ADF helicopter retirement and defence spending shifts marginal capital.
sectors.implications: Energy names (WES.AX, SXG.AX, AGL.AX) face demand tailwind from data centres but capex constraints. Monitor gas pricing.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to 40-year decline; Victorian unemployment worst-hit. CBD commercial tower listed at $40m signals softening. Renters' financial stress at 50%+.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Residential builders (GRO.AX, MHC.AX) under pressure. Defensive REITs (healthcare, infrastructure) preferred.

sectors.trend: AI adoption accelerating in small business; OpenAI security breaches and Medicare data breach prompt regulatory calls (Pocock AI safety act). Jensen Huang/Trump AI narrative dominates global tech.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, SVL.AX) benefit from AI capex but face regulatory overhang. Cybersecurity names gain from breach headlines.

sectors.trend: Interest-rate pincer squeezing middle-income households; renter stress at 50%+. Bentley EV at $325k signals premium auto segment. Star casino suspension hits discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX, CBA.AX consumer lending under pressure. CSL.AX, SGH.AX (health) offer defensive exposure. Gaming (SGH.AX) hit by licence suspension.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: unemployment rising but RBA committed to further hikes, creating stagflationary risk
AUD weakness: 'trapdoor' dynamics from rate differential and global risk-off
Property correction: 40-year high decline underway, concentrated in Victoria
Gold exploration renaissance: multiple high-grade hits in WA and West Africa
Capital raise flood: $2.7B weekly dilution pressuring small/mid-cap valuations
Energy-demand mismatch: data centre boom vs supply constraints
Geopolitical commodity risk: China-Trump alignment shift affecting iron ore/coal demand
AI regulation: Medicare breach and OpenAI hacks accelerating Australian AI safety legislation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid rising unemployment (stagflation risk)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); underweight rate-sensitive growth and property

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD sustained weakness compressing importer margins and commodity exporter valuations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property market 40-year decline triggering credit losses at banks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NPL trends at CBA.AX, NAB.AX; favour banks with lower residential exposure (ANZ.AX, WBC.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: $2.7B weekly capital raises diluting small/mid-cap shareholders
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid pre-announcement small-caps; favour cash-flow-positive miners with limited dilution history

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China-US geopolitical shift disrupting commodity demand (iron ore, coal, LNG)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-exposed miners; favour gold (hedge) and domestic energy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre boom
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO capacity warnings; favour integrated energy producers with long-term offtake

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and producers as safe-haven and inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 WA) signal sector re-rating; AUD weakness and RBA hikes support gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples for portfolio stability
opportunities.rationale: Stagflationary environment favours pricing power and essential-demand names; CSL and Wesfarmers offer resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure tied to data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural power demand from AI/data centres supports long-term energy pricing; favour integrated producers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential property and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline underway; Victorian unemployment and renter stress threaten occupancy and valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim China-exposed large-cap miners pending geopolitical clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: China-Trump alignment shift creates demand uncertainty for iron ore and coal; AUD weakness partially offsets but direction unclear

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap miners with pending capital raises
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B weekly raise volume creates dilution overhang; favour cash-generative names

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Fourth consecutive losing week, rising bond yields, RBA hawkish bias, and AUD weakness create a hostile backdrop. Expect continued ASX 200 (^AXJO) weakness into 3,000 support. Gold and defensives outperform. Small-caps pressured by dilution.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. RBA hiking cycle nearing terminal rate; property correction nearing completion. Gold exploration pipeline and data-centre energy demand offer structural growth. Key risk is prolonged stagflation if unemployment keeps rising without growth recovery.
key_catalysts: Next RBA board decision and cash rate guidance
